title: MLAG Domain-ID Mismatch — dc1-leaf2a peer negotiation fails
symptom: MLAG negotiation status on dc1-leaf2a shows Inactive. Both dc1-leaf2a and dc1-leaf2b report Active state simultaneously. MLAG port-channels going inactive.
root_cause: mlag domain-id changed to WRONG_DOMAIN on dc1-leaf2a — domain-id mismatch with dc1-leaf2b (DC1_L3_LEAF2)
